<style>{`
  /* ─── Hide page chrome for landing page feel ─── */
  nav[aria-label="breadcrumb"],
  [class*="breadcrumb"],
  [class*="Breadcrumb"],
  [data-testid="breadcrumb"],
  [class*="page-feedback"],
  [class*="pageFeedback"],
  [data-testid*="feedback"],
  [class*="page-nav"],
  [class*="pageNav"],
  [class*="next-prev"] {
    display: none !important;
  }

  /* ─── Hero ─── */
  .cap-hero {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 3.5rem 1.5rem 2.5rem;
  }

  .cap-hero h1 {
    font-size: 2.5rem !important;
    font-weight: 750 !important;
    letter-spacing: -0.035em !important;
    line-height: 1.15 !important;
    color: var(--text-primary) !important;
    margin-bottom: 0.75rem !important;
  }

  .cap-hero-sub {
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    max-width: 560px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    line-height: 1.65;
  }

  /* ─── Section labels ─── */
  .cap-label {
    display: inline-block;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--brand);
    margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
  }

  .cap-section h2 {
    font-size: 1.4rem !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em !important;
    color: var(--text-primary) !important;
    margin-top: 0 !important;
    margin-bottom: 0.3rem !important;
    border: none !important;
  }

  .cap-desc {
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    line-height: 1.6;
    margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
  }

  /* ─── Divider ─── */
  .cap-divider {
    border: none;
    height: 1px;
    background: var(--divider);
    margin: 2.5rem 0 2rem;
  }

  /* ─── Product cards ─── */
  .cap-products .dai-card {
    border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
  }

  .cap-products .dai-card-image {
    aspect-ratio: 2 / 1;
    object-fit: cover;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .cap-products .dai-card-body {
    padding: 1.15rem 1.25rem 1.3rem;
  }

  .cap-products .dai-card-title {
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    font-weight: 700;
  }

  .cap-products .dai-card-description {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }

  /* ─── Migration cards ─── */
  .cap-migration .dai-card-horizontal {
    border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 1.1rem 1.25rem;
    gap: 1.1rem;
  }

  .cap-migration .dai-card-horizontal .dai-card-icon {
    width: 48px;
    height: 48px;
    min-width: 48px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1341A9 0%, #3b63c9 100%);
    color: #ffffff !important;
    box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(19, 65, 169, 0.25);
  }

  .dark .cap-migration .dai-card-horizontal .dai-card-icon {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2d5fd6 0%, #5b7ed6 100%);
    box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(45, 95, 214, 0.3);
  }

  .cap-migration .dai-card-horizontal .dai-card-icon svg {
    stroke: #ffffff !important;
    color: #ffffff !important;
  }

  .cap-migration .dai-card-horizontal .dai-card-title {
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    font-weight: 650;
  }

  .cap-migration .dai-card-horizontal .dai-card-description {
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    line-height: 1.55;
  }

  /* ─── Footer ─── */
  .cap-footer {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 2rem 1rem 0.5rem;
    font-size: 0.88rem;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
  }

  .cap-footer a {
    color: var(--brand);
    font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
`}</style>
